sourceReview.reason: Six-hour retry hold: full-text CryptoCompass article dated 2026-11-19 (https://cryptocompass.com/articles/blackrock-says-tokenized-assets-are-0-01-of-global-markets-pointing-to-early-stage-adoption) attributes $30-40bn on-chain assets versus $300tn traditional markets to BlackRock's Will Su, but explicitly republishes BSC News; the Binance Square copy is the same syndicated report, not independent corroboration. Neither a dated original BlackRock statement nor two independent full-text reports verifying the quotation and 0.01% calculation were established. Other historical BUIDL figures do not verify this November claim. No three independently anchored event facts; retry after six hours, do not publish.
